about.en: Hewlett Packard Enterprise bStock (HPEB) is a tokenized share of Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company issued by BTECH Holdings Ltd, a special purpose vehicle registered in the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), under Binance's bStocks brand. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain at 0xd56eb30d2ea7b5866dc0066d33bbaab36f7e8860, backed 1:1 by HPE shares and convertible 1:1 with the underlying equity, with stock splits and dividend adjustments processed by the issuer. bStocks are offered under an ADGM-approved prospectus and not in other jurisdictions.
